question:
Simplify the expression: 

 ((64)/(125))⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾times sqrt[4]{8}times ((8)/(27))⁽³⁾/⁽⁴⁾
solution:
**Given:**

 ((64)/(125))⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ times sqrt[4]{8} times ((8)/(27))⁽³⁾/⁽⁴⁾ 

**Formula used:**

 am/ⁿ = (sqrt[n]{a})^m 

 a^m times a^n = am⁺ⁿ 

**Calculation:**

 ((64)/(125))⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ times sqrt[4]{8} times ((8)/(27))⁽³⁾/⁽⁴⁾ 

⇒ frac{(2⁶)²/³}{(5³)²/³} times (2³)¹/⁴ times frac{(2³)³/⁴}{(3³)³/⁴} 

⇒ frac{2¹²/³}{5²} times 2³/⁴ times frac{2⁹/⁴}{3⁹/⁴} 

⇒ (2⁴)/(25) times frac{2³/⁴ ⁺ ⁹/⁴}{3⁹/⁴} 

⇒ (16)/(25) times frac{2¹²/⁴}{3⁹/⁴} 

⇒ (16)/(25) times (2³)/(3⁹/⁴⁾ 

⇒ (128)/(5² times 3⁹/⁴⁾ 

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
